name: For The Horde!
label: Quest
description: For The Horde!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Rend dares make such grand claims because of the protection he is afforded by the black flight.
You, friend, will find a way to pass through the Halls of Ascension. You will then find 'Warchief' Rend Blackhand and you will destroy him - FOR THE HORDE!
The next time you return to my chambers, you will hold his head high in triumph and then you shall present it to your Warchief. Do this and be honored as a hero of the Horde.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have dealt a crippling blow to the forces of Blackrock, friend. With their Warchief slain, the Blackrock legion is once again thrown into the maw of chaos.
In honor of your heroics, the people of Kalimdor shall be rewarded!
